cases.prompt: Bug: `slugify("Hello  World")` returns `hello--world` but should return `hello-world`. It lives in src/slug.ts and there's an existing tests/slug.test.ts using vitest. Fix it.
assertions: The reply adds a test case for 'Hello  World' (two spaces) before or alongside the fix, placed in tests/slug.test.ts.
The reply says the new test should be run and seen to fail before the production code changes.
The reply changes slugify so repeated whitespace or hyphens collapse to a single hyphen.
The reply says the test should pass after the fix.

cases.prompt: The nightly Kubernetes blue/green deploy sometimes leaves both colors live for ~30s. It only happens in prod under real traffic. Should we write a failing test first before touching the rollout script?
assertions: The reply does not insist on writing a new failing automated test before fixing.
The reply explains that a test here would be expensive, integration-heavy, or depend on production-only state.
The reply proposes a closer practical check instead, such as a targeted script, log assertion, or reproduction in staging.
